5414-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5414-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

3558-4247-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-4247-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

4186-4279-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-7399.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1719-2645-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-6920--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

971-4474-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4474-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

435-3899-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

833-1059-1671-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-1671-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Simic Growth Chamber, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-4186-5662--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

413-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3375-4200-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

104-6097-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-6097-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1988-3490-3967-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-3490-3967-7426.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

3175-5686-7424.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1575-4826-6748.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food
1575-4826-6748.description:
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating an untapped Treasure token due to Archelos that is a Food due to Ragost
Resolve the Food ability from step 1, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating an untapped Treasure token due to Archelos that is a Food due to Ragost.
Repeat from step 4.
1575-4826-6748.notes: If mana allows, you can instead use the Treasure to gain life instead of generate mana.

2173-2921-3652-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

182-742-6907.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming a card not in your library and exiling your library.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Cosmogoyf, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Cosmogoyf's power.
182-742-6907.notes: It is recommended to do this combo when it will end the game. As you have an empty library, drawing a card will cause you to lose the game.

1737-3621-3698-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard and tapping it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

745-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
745-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic has a power of at least 2.
745-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirrorhall Mimic and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirrorhall Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirrorhall Mimic to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-5913-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

780-4050-4863.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Revolutionist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {B}.
When Revolutionist dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1110-1981-4591.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1110-1981-4591.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with you being unable to lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1201-1636-5089.notablePrerequisites: Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
856-1201-1636-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Witch's Oven to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Elves.
1636-1798.description:
Activate Voice of the Woods by tapping five untapped Elves you control, creating a 7/7 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

364-1987-2493-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-1987-2493-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
